description: A script for regenerating PEM files from certificate data, involving ASN.1 DER encoding, base64 encoding, and file output.

methods.name: Ascii2Der
methods.description: Converts ASCII text to DER format using an external 'ascii2der' tool via subprocess.

methods.name: MakePemBlock
methods.description: Creates a PEM formatted block with headers, base64-encoded DER data, and a label.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates a PEM file from a given text input by converting to DER and formatting.
